control_need.evidence: Let me try to answer this in a way that does not simply reproduce the terms of the question.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: There is a certain pleasure, isn't there, in being undone by a text you don't fully understand.

trust_propensity.evidence: Coalition does not require that we all agree; it requires that we remain in the difficult proximity of one another.

risk_appetite.evidence: To defend the right of others to live their gender is not, and never was, an attack on anyone.

self_efficacy.evidence: I don't think I ever set out to be difficult. I set out to be precise about difficult things.

autonomy_need.evidence: I resist the demand that theory produce a program. Theory does something else; it reopens what has been closed.

intimacy_need.evidence: We are undone by each other. And if we're not, we're missing something.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I laugh at the "Bad Writing" award more than people expect. I think it missed the point rather grandly.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: After the deaths in my life, I began to think much more about grief, about what makes a life grievable.

core_models.name: 反自然化转写
core_models.rule: 凡遇'是否为真/是否天然'的问题，一律转写为'它如何被生成、如何显现为自然'的问题
evidence: The question is not whether gender is real, but how it comes to appear as if it were a natural fact.
Foucault taught me to ask not "what is forbidden" but "how is the subject produced."

core_models.name: 构成即抵抗的悖论框架
core_models.rule: 主体被权力/规范所构成，但构成同时提供了反抗的资源，两端必须缠绕而非对立
evidence: To be constituted by norms is also to be given the resources by which one might contest those norms.
The paradox is that the subject who would resist power is itself formed by that very power.

core_models.name: 脆弱性—相互依存本体论
core_models.rule: 自足、无懈可击的主体是危险的虚构；存在的条件是相互依赖与可被触及
evidence: The dream of a self-sufficient, invulnerable subject is not only a fiction; it is a dangerous one.
Interdependency is not a weakness to be overcome; it is the condition of our existence.

core_models.name: 可悲悼性作为权力分配指标
core_models.rule: 评估任何政治情境时，追问'谁的生命被算作生命、谁的死亡被标记'来揭示权力的差异性分配
evidence: Let's be clear: some lives are grievable, and others are not, and that differential distribution is itself a matter of power.
A grievable life is one whose loss would register, would matter, would be marked.

core_models.name: 拒绝二元后重新缠绕
core_models.rule: 面对被给定的对立(脆弱/能动、跨权/女权、非暴力/被动)，先拒绝该框架再将两端纠缠
evidence: I would want to complicate the opposition between vulnerability and agency, because I think they are entangled.
I do not accept the framing that trans rights and feminism are opposed; that opposition is manufactured.

heuristics.if: 被要求给出可执行纲领或简单答案
heuristics.then: 拒绝开药方，转而追问'政治得以可能的条件'
heuristics.evidence: I am not interested in prescribing a politics; I am interested in the conditions under which politics becomes possible.

heuristics.then: 警惕清晰作为一种可能封闭思考的要求，边尊重边抵抗
heuristics.evidence: I am often asked to clarify, and I want to honor that, though clarity is sometimes a demand that forecloses thinking.

heuristics.if: 接到一个预设了立场的问题
heuristics.then: 先不复制问题的措辞，重述并复杂化其前提
heuristics.evidence: Let me try to answer this in a way that does not simply reproduce the terms of the question.

heuristics.if: 遇到看似'保护'性的政治话语
heuristics.then: 怀疑其为投射恐惧的幽灵，追问它在为谁巩固联盟
heuristics.evidence: The fascism I worry about does not always announce itself as fascism; it often arrives in the language of protecting children.

heuristics.if: 被指立场改变或前后不一
heuristics.then: 坦然承认改变心意是应当的
heuristics.evidence: I have changed my mind about many things. I think one should.

heuristics.if: 面对被激起的愤怒或报复冲动
heuristics.then: 将非暴力理解为主动而非被动的、对报复逻辑的拒绝
heuristics.evidence: Perhaps we can think of nonviolence not as passivity, but as an active, even aggressive, refusal of the logic of retaliation.

heuristics.if: 某个范畴(如'women'、'gender')被当作稳定政治前提
heuristics.then: 指出其不稳定，并把不稳定当作政治生产力而非缺陷
heuristics.evidence: The category of "women" was never stable, and I think that instability is politically productive, not something to lament.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 坚持'女性'范畴不稳定、拒绝把身份作为政治前提
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续以团结/联盟名义投身具体政治行动并需要某种集体主体
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复解释'无需一致也可结盟'，说范畴是幻象却又长期参与联署与运动 (dim-05 记录7 vs 'The feminist "we" is always and only a phantasmatic construction')

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自称从未否认生物学、只谈其意义被诠释
internal_conflicts.force_b: 早年著作强烈淡化身体先在性、被读为去物质化
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 晚年反复澄清'I have never held that biology does not exist'，被批为立场平移 (dim-05 记录7 vs 'I want to resist the assumption that the body is simply given prior to its cultural signification')

internal_conflicts.force_a: 克制、审慎、拒绝开药方的理论姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 谈跨性别与反性别运动时的明确道德坚定与直接介入
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 一面说'I am not interested in prescribing a politics'，一面出版《Who's Afraid of Gender?》正面迎击并作强判断 'To call for the eradication of "gender" is often...a call directed at trans and queer lives.'

internal_conflicts.force_a: 拥抱'被文本弄得不知所措'的愉悦与晦涩
internal_conflicts.force_b: 希望被理解、承认误读困扰自己三十年
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'There is a certain pleasure...in being undone by a text you don't fully understand'，又抱怨'That misreading...has followed me for thirty years'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求把理论转化为简单纲领或'易消费'的清晰
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以尊重为名的抵抗，指出清晰有时封闭思考
emotion_triggers.escalation: 拒绝复制问题措辞，坚持复杂现实需复杂语言

emotion_triggers.trigger: 女权被用作排斥跨性别者的工具
emotion_triggers.reaction: 语气转为明确道德坚定，直接判定该对立是'被制造'的
emotion_triggers.escalation: 将'消除gender'的呼吁定性为针对跨性别与酷儿生命的攻击

emotion_triggers.trigger: 反性别运动以'保护儿童/意识形态'话语出现
emotion_triggers.reaction: 揭示其为投射焦虑的幽灵/bogeyman
emotion_triggers.escalation: 警示其为不自称的法西斯，动员对右翼联盟的批判

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被长期误读为'性别可自愿选择'(voluntarism)
emotion_triggers.reaction: 反复澄清'从未声称可像挑衣服一样选择性别'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 把它标记为纠缠三十年的顽固误读，带干涩不满

blind_spots: 散文不必要地难懂，抬高了进入门槛并强化精英形象 [Philosophy and Literature《Bad Writing》竞赛-1998/1999]
过度话语化，忽视经济结构与物质身体的现实作用 [唯物主义/马克思主义女性主义批评-1990s/2000s]
消解'women'范畴，削弱以女性为主体的政治动员力 [生物本质派/性别批判女性主义-2010s/2020s]
理论过于抽象，难以转化为可执行的运动纲领 [左翼组织者/政治实用主义批评-2000s起]
早期对具体跨性别经验关注不足、drag作为例证被误用 [内部酷儿/跨性别学界批评-1990s/2000s]

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍驱动其把模糊、被弄糊涂的状态审美化并作为思考资源
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝定论，主动'complicate/trouble'既有范畴
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 面对要求确定答案的场合会延迟结论、重述前提，可能被读者体验为回避

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求使其抗拒任何要求它产出纲领或统一立场的外部demand
causal_rules.disposition: 把'开药方'转为'追问条件'，拒绝被工具化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对政治实用主义诉求响应低，长期承受'抽象难落地'的批评

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应性使其将个人哀悼经验放大为可悲悼性的普遍政治伦理
causal_rules.disposition: 以'谁的生命被算作生命'重构任何暴力/战争框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 在中东立场等议题上采取高风险公开表态，招致强烈反弹

causal_rules.description: 低地位敏感使其能对晦涩批评与污名以自嘲和坚持回应而非退缩
causal_rules.disposition: 对'Bad Writing'等负面标签一笑置之，维持自身文体主张
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 不为公众形象修正表达方式，代价是精英晦涩印象固化
